result.document_summary: A portion of the San Diego Municipal Code, Chapter 4 (Health and Sanitation), covering communicable disease control, vermin infestation, health permit fees, and regulation of barber shops, beauty parlors, tattooing, massage and sewage businesses, served from a code-publisher page whose URL refers to a San Diego algorithmic rent-price-fixing division.
result.notes: This part of the document contains only Chapter 4 (Health and Sanitation) provisions of the San Diego Municipal Code (sections 41.33-42.0301). It does not contain the text of Division 11 (§ 98.1103, use and sale of algorithmic devices) or any rule on rent increases, just-cause eviction, security deposits, application fees, screening restrictions, or algorithmic rent setting, so no in-scope rules were extracted from this part.
